title: Correct final answer
description: Essential: The response must give the rate of change of shadow length as Lv/(h-L).

title: Similar triangles setup
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify and apply similar triangles between the person, light, and shadow.

title: Position variables defined
description: Important: The solution must define variables for the person's position and the shadow tip position relative to the pole.

title: Differentiation step
description: Important: The solution must correctly differentiate the shadow length expression with respect to time.

title: Constant speed substitution
description: Optional: The solution explicitly substitutes dx/dt = v for the person's walking speed.

title: Units consistency
description: Optional: The solution mentions or implies consistent units for the final rate.

title: Incorrect triangle ratio
description: Pitfall: The solution incorrectly sets up the similar triangles ratio (e.g., h/L = (shadow+person)/shadow).

title: Sign or derivative error
description: Pitfall: The solution makes an error in differentiating the expression for shadow length.
